verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat runs inside the GitLab UI with access to project issues, merge requests, commits and CI/CD pipelines. It can search those resources and provide advice or propose solutions, which covers the core of AI suggestions drawn from the user's data. Proactive or analytic insights over that data, such as trends or summaries surfaced without being asked, are not documented, and nothing independent shows the advice quality. Missing for 10: documented proactive/analytic insight generation over project data (e.g., summaries, trend detection), hands-on or independent corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Chat has access to your project, including issues, merge requests, commits, and CI/CD pipelines, and Chat maintains context across conversations.
It can provide advice, but it can also propose and implement solutions.
GitLab Duo Chat is available in: The GitLab UI.
agentic Chat can search for these resources without requiring you to specify exact IDs or URLs
